_comment: Workbook exercise air-excess-oa-cost, the airflow lesson: the main run plus the design outdoor airflow of the unit that trends no supply airflow (report.rcx.loads: AHU__excess_oa_no_flow design_oa_cfm 2400). With no trended airflow and no supply_airflow_cfm, the estimate takes the supply airflow the declared minimum implies, 2400 / 0.20 = 12,000 cfm: the unit's design flow, which a VAV unit reaches only at full load.
